검은 우주 구체가 된 네보리 Nebori Black-Orb Head Variant Nebori becomes a gentle black cosmic orb Nebori Black-Orb Head Variant

보라색 네뷸라의 인상은 남기고, 얼굴 중심을 둥근 검은 구체로 바꿨습니다. 밝은 눈과 작은 입은 자연스러운 색으로 정리했습니다. 기존 비픽셀 머리형의 실루엣과 1024px 배치를 유지하면서 중앙 코어만 구체형 얼굴로 교체했습니다. 알파 경계에는 1px contraction과 despill을 적용했습니다. The violet nebula identity remains, while the center is now a rounded black orb with softly colored eyes and a small mouth. The existing non-pixel head silhouette and 1024px placement are preserved. Only the central core was replaced, followed by 1px alpha contraction and chroma despill.

[자세히] 디자인 결정[Details] Design decisions
  • 검은 얼굴은 납작한 원이 아니라, 빛을 아주 조금 받는 둥근 구체처럼 보이게 했습니다.
  • 눈은 따뜻한 아이보리와 옅은 청록 사이의 색으로, 입은 보라색에 가까운 작은 곡선으로 정리했습니다.
  • 기존 보라색 네뷸라 모양과 떠다니는 작은 입자는 유지했습니다.
  • Orb material: near-black charcoal core, midnight-navy falloff, restrained violet reflected rim, soft upper-left specular cue.
  • Face contrast: warm ivory/pale-cyan eyes and muted lavender mouth. No teeth, nose, brows, skin, robot panel, or emoji treatment.
  • Identity preservation: upper wisp, lower-left mass, upper-right negative-space opening, particles, and final alpha bbox retained.
  • The face reads as a softly lit sphere, not a flat black circle.
  • The eyes use warm ivory with a pale-cyan cast. The tiny mouth stays close to the violet palette.
  • The original nebula silhouette and floating particles remain recognizable.
  • Orb material: near-black charcoal core, midnight-navy falloff, restrained violet reflected rim, and a soft upper-left specular cue.
  • Face contrast: warm ivory/pale-cyan eyes and muted lavender mouth. No teeth, nose, brows, skin, robot panel, or emoji treatment.
  • Identity preservation: upper wisp, lower-left mass, upper-right negative-space opening, particles, and final alpha bbox retained.

[자세히] 생성 방식과 프롬프트[Details] Generation method and prompt

OpenAI 내장 imagegen의 로컬 이미지 편집 모드를 사용했습니다. Pixy는 사용하지 않았습니다. The local-image edit mode of OpenAI built-in imagegen was used. Pixy was not used. 

Preserve the centered non-pixel head-only Nebori composition and the violet nebula silhouette. Replace only the pale-cyan central core with a near-black spherical cosmic orb using restrained charcoal, midnight-navy, and violet reflected light. Add two small warm-ivory/pale-cyan eyes and a very small muted-lavender friendly-neutral mouth. Avoid flat disks, holes, robot screens, glossy plastic, human anatomy, emoji styling, text, and extra colors. Render on a uniform #00FF00 chroma background for transparent extraction.

후처리: auto-key border, soft matte, transparent threshold 55, opaque threshold 170, despill, edge-contract 1, Lanczos resize, metadata-free optimized PNG. Post-process: auto-key border, soft matte, transparent threshold 55, opaque threshold 170, despill, edge-contract 1, Lanczos resize, metadata-free optimized PNG.

[자세히] 위험과 롤백[Details] Risks and rollback

아주 작은 40px 아이콘에서는 입이 거의 보이지 않을 수 있습니다. 눈과 구체 실루엣은 유지됩니다. 기존 파일은 덮어쓰지 않았으므로 새 파일을 사용하지 않으면 바로 원래 모습으로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.

Residual risk: the 40px rendition prioritizes eyes and orb silhouette, so the 6px-scale mouth becomes secondary. Rollback is a path-level swap because the source asset remains untouched and the new output is additive.

At a very small 40px icon size, the mouth may nearly disappear. The eyes and orb silhouette remain readable. The source file was not overwritten, so rollback is immediate.

Residual risk: the 40px rendition prioritizes eyes and orb silhouette, so the 6px-scale mouth becomes secondary. Rollback is a path-level swap because the source asset remains untouched and the new output is additive.
